subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should #41165 be fixed narrowly by changing heartbeat wake-session precedence first, or should it also change the documented Telegram DM default away from main-session sharing?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence issue is a concrete bug, but Telegram DM default isolation conflicts with current docs, tests, and compatibility expectations, so automation should not silently choose that product policy.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win over event-provided wake session keys and keep Telegram DM defaults governed by `session.dmScope`.

options.title: Also change Telegram DM defaults
options.body: Adopt per-peer Telegram DM isolation by default with docs, tests, migration/upgrade proof, and a compatibility plan for current main-session users.

options.title: Wait for PR 1542 refresh
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on the linked fork PR until it is made mergeable and narrowed to an approved product boundary.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win over event-provided wake session keys and keep Telegram DM defaults governed by `session.dmScope`.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest available routing owner for deciding whether this stays a narrow heartbeat bug fix or becomes a Telegram session-default product change.
